card.name: School staff and facility lists
card.fires_on: Commas, linking words and modifiers inside lists of school roles or school spaces (teachers, administrators, gym, computer lab), just before the next list item.

modes.label: List of school staff
modes.description: Comma or word after a school role, where another role is about to be named.
modes.example: Teachers<<,>> recess monitors, hall monitors, bus drivers

modes.label: School facilities
modes.description: Article, comma or modifier in a list of rooms in a school building.
modes.example: a stage, a gym, a<< computer>> lab and administrative offices

modes.label: School as modifier
modes.description: The word school or your before a school-related noun like gym or administrators.
modes.example: parents, teachers and<< school>> administrators also feel like

card.writes: It slightly promotes the word media, which suggests school-setting words such as media center or library media.
card.plain: It fires in school texts when a list of staff or rooms is being built, as if a word like media might come next.
